sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
incomplete

Diana is one of the Sacred Guardians of Meirith, who devoted their life into protecting the Holy Emperor Karna Masta. Born in the La Veda Republic as a daughter of a fisherman, she has an exceptional talent with the saber. This is why she was appointed as a Guardian. She harbors deep feelings towards her fellow Guardian, Quaid.
